modifications..gitignore: Scope ignores to generated configuration, generated runtime types, dependency and build artifacts, and local secret values.
modifications.package.json: Declare supported Node.js versions, add the Wrangler dry-run build and D1 initialization, and pin SimpleWebAuthn server for cross-platform passkey verification.
modifications.package-lock.json: Repair upstream reproducible install metadata and lock the added SimpleWebAuthn runtime dependency and transitive packages.
modifications.tsconfig.json: Include permanent environment secret binding declarations for type checks without local secret values.
modifications.src/crawl.ts: Normalize trusted sitemap origin aliases and configured homepage page aliases to the canonical site; preserve child sitemap paths, restrict fetch origins, normalize snapshot comparison identity, and refresh open finding severity in place.
modifications.test/crawl.test.ts: Cover trusted origin and homepage normalization, exact alias boundaries, child sitemap preservation, canonical fetches, snapshot comparison, and safe redirect rejection.
modifications.src/actions.ts: Normalize new manual proposal and dry-run paths through explicit homepage aliases while retaining historical proposal and journal paths.
modifications.src/aeo.ts: Treat missing optional llms.txt as informational and explain that it is not required for Google Search visibility or ranking.
modifications.src/config.ts: Read explicit homepage path aliases as exact paths from the environment.
modifications.src/pagepath.ts: Provide exact-match canonical homepage alias mapping without broad URL normalization.
modifications.src/rules.ts: Refresh existing open finding severity and detail while preserving finding identity and dismissal history.
modifications.test/aeo.test.ts: Verify optional llms.txt is reported as informational.
modifications.test/findings.test.ts: Cover open finding severity and detail refresh without identity changes or reopening dismissals.
modifications.test/propose.test.ts: Cover canonical paths for new proposals and dry runs while preserving historical proposal paths and revert behavior.
modifications.src/index.ts: Dispatch authentication ceremonies and allow scoped dashboard REST sessions while retaining bearer-only MCP/internal context, token precedence, existing approvals and private cache/security headers.
modifications.README.md: Document cross-platform dashboard passkeys, token recovery, scoped browser sessions and AUTH_ORIGIN; remove obsolete browser token persistence claims.
modifications.schema.sql: Add isolated passkey public-key, expiring challenge and hashed browser-session tables without changing existing application data.
modifications.src/dashboard.ts: Add browser passkey sign-in, protected enrollment/revocation, secure-cookie session discovery, WebAuthn binary compatibility conversions and CSRF requests; remove persistent token storage and clear stale session data.

addedFiles.env.d.ts: Permanent binding types for explicit authentication origin, control credentials, trusted aliases and optional internal-context providers; contains names/types only.
addedFiles.src/internal-llms.ts: Authenticated HTTPS-only internal document delivery with explicit software AES-256-GCM or independently authenticated YubiKey host bridge, strict context/configuration checks, bounded text, deadlines, enrollment fingerprint binding and private failures; hardware mode has no software fallback.
addedFiles.test/internal-llms.test.ts: Synthetic cryptographic and access-control coverage for internal document authentication, context binding, tampering, malformed configuration, bounds, private headers, HTTPS and HEAD/method behavior.
addedFiles.test/yubikey-bridge.test.ts: Synthetic bridge protocol coverage for authentication before contact, independent credentials, HTTPS destination validation, provider isolation, enrolled key pinning, bounded UTF-8 streaming, stalled reads, failures and HEAD semantics.
addedFiles.src/auth.ts: Origin-bound WebAuthn verification with required user verification, bearer-only enrollment/revocation, browser-bound single-use D1 challenges, hashed eight-hour dashboard sessions, atomic counter commits, token rotation and sanitized failures.
addedFiles.test/auth.test.ts: Authorization, origin/CSRF, session scope, method, bounded-body, malformed-cookie and storage-failure coverage for the authentication boundary.
addedFiles.test/dashboard-auth.test.ts: Behavioral browser VM coverage for passkey options/serialization, token recovery, enrollment/revocation, session discovery, cancellation, no storage persistence and stale data cleanup.

notes: originalFiles hashes describe the exact upstream commit, not modified vendored files.
files hashes describe the checked-in vendored files after integration changes; generated runtime and deployment artifacts are excluded.
The root Ecosystem deployment orchestrator generates wrangler.jsonc from config/seo-agent.json.
Upstream files retain original bytes except the documented patchedPaths; originalFiles hashes remain unchanged for the pinned upstream commit.
